title: SOUL Meeting
label: COMMUNICATION PLATFORM
description: A bold vision for accessible, cross-platform video meetings and collaboration.
detail: SOUL is a concept for a modern video meeting platform across Web, Android, iOS and Windows, designed with affordability, useful collaboration tools and large meetings in mind.

title: HeatScope
label: ANDROID UTILITY
description: Smarter device insights for performance, battery usage and thermal behavior.
detail: HeatScope explores a privacy-minded Android utility that helps people understand which background activities may contribute to device heat and drain, with clear, honest diagnostics.

title: Chunk Locker
label: SECURITY PRODUCT
description: A privacy-minded approach to file protection and digital ownership.
detail: Chunk Locker represents the idea that strong data protection should still feel approachable, usable and under the user’s control.

title: Emberfall Kingdoms
label: GAME DEVELOPMENT
description: A fantasy strategy game world filled with kingdoms, progression, and adventure.
detail: Emberfall Kingdoms is a game development project exploring evolving heroes, armies, environments and upgradeable buildings with visually distinct progression.

title: Tele God
label: AUTOMATION SYSTEM
description: Fast event-driven Telegram workflow experiments with efficient processing.
detail: Tele God explores Telegram monitoring and forwarding automation, with an emphasis on response speed, resource efficiency and dependable background processing.
